_about: Every free provider and every text-capable model from the source list (embeddings excluded: they cannot answer a prompt). The app reads only this file, never the internet list. Providers with a key in .env, and keyless providers (only with LLM_ALLOW_KEYLESS=true; off by default), join the chain; check.py and bench.py decide which models stay. Entries marked de_verificat need a live check before they are trusted.
source: https://github.com/mnfst/awesome-free-llm-apis (README.md + data.json, lastUpdated in repo). The originally requested list github.com/cheahjs/free-llm-api-resources returns 404 (repository removed); its mirror jtig37/free-llm-api-resources was last updated 2024-08-21 and is too old to use.

providers.name: Google Gemini

limits.note: Google no longer publishes per-model free-tier limits; check quotas in AI Studio. de_verificat

notes: Free-tier prompts may be used by Google to improve products (except EEA/CH/UK users).
Terms: an API client made available to users in the EEA, CH or UK must use Paid Services. Relevant if the app is used by people in Romania beyond a demo.
gemini-3.1-flash-lite is deprecated (shutdown 2027-05-07).
Model order: the two models that answered the live check on 2026-11-14 come first (used when no chain_order.json exists).

providers.name: Groq

limits.note: 8,000 TPM, 200,000 TPD per model on the Free Plan

notes: No credit card. Very fast inference.

providers.name: OpenRouter

limits.note: Counted across ALL free models together; 1,000 RPD after buying 10 credits

notes: Free providers may log prompts for training.

providers.name: Cohere

limits.note: Trial key: 1,000 API calls per MONTH; non-commercial use only

notes: Aya Expanse is multilingual; worth benchmarking for Romanian.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM

limits.note: No public table; varies per model and load. de_verificat

notes: 100+ models: the rest come from /v1/models discovery.
Prototyping/testing only; production needs an NVIDIA AI Enterprise licence.
Trial use: do not submit personal data; usage is logged.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI

limits.note: 10,000 Neurons/day shared across all models, reset 00:00 UTC; over the limit the request fails (no billing)

notes: Needs the account id in the URL as well as the token.
55+ more models via discovery; 7 named models need the paid plan.

providers.name: Z AI (Zhipu)
notes: International endpoint (api.z.ai) serves the same free models; mainland endpoint: https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4.
OpenAI-compatible chat/completions shape: de_verificat.

providers.name: Aion Labs
notes: Specialised for roleplay and storytelling; likely weak for structured JSON.
OpenAI compatibility not stated explicitly: de_verificat.

providers.name: Gonka Broker

limits.note: ~1M tokens/MONTH shared; lower rate on free funds (maxRpm from /test-auth)

notes: Requires SMS verification with a real phone number.
BAAI/bge-m3 not listed: embeddings model, cannot answer a prompt.

providers.name: LLM7.io

limits.note: Free token: 1 RPS, 60 RPM, 250 req/hour, 100K tokens/24h; may be reduced without notice

notes: Works anonymously too (no key); catalog rotates often.

providers.name: Kilo Code gateway

limits.note: 200 requests/hour per IP for free models

notes: Free models need no API key.
kilo-auto/free may route to providers that log prompts and outputs; NVIDIA endpoints: trial use, no personal data, logged.
Catalog can lag what is served.

providers.name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints

limits.note: Anonymous: 2 RPM per IP per model. With a key: 400 RPM but billed pay-as-you-go

notes: Free only WITHOUT a key; a key switches to paid usage.
Hosted in the EU.
Mistral-Small-3.2 end of life 2026-11-04 (already passed): de_verificat.
send_key=false: the chain never sends a key here (a key means paid usage).

providers.name: ModelScope
notes: Requires Alibaba Cloud binding + real-name verification; cannot be tested from outside mainland China.
Used when its key is in .env; registration needs mainland-China verification.

providers.name: SiliconFlow
notes: Real-name verification with mainland-Chinese documents; cannot be tested from outside mainland China.
Hunyuan-MT is a translation model.
Used when its key is in .env; registration needs mainland-China verification.
